issues.description: The problem description uses a different method name style for the total-students method: it refers to get_total_number_of_students() (snake_case) in the prose, while the UML and the intended implementation use getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase). This naming inconsistency between the prose and the UML/solution can confuse students about the exact method name they should implement and may lead to failing exercises if tests expect the camelCase name.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. Update the problem statement prose to use getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase) to match the UML, the template comments, and the solution. Ensure any example text and hints reference the camelCase name so students implement the correct method signature.
